summary: Coya Therapeutics filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market (ATM) common stock offering of up to $30 million through Leerink Partners as sales agent. The filing is a routine shelf takedown under Rule 415(a)(4), not a special situation. The stock closed at $4.11 on May 8, 2026. Leerink receives a 3% commission; no escrow or trust arrangement exists. As an ATM program, there is no fixed price, premium, or tender. No board recommendation, advisor, or structural changes are involved. The filing is an ordinary capital-raising mechanism, not an event-driven special situation. There is no risk-arb angle; what to watch is the pace of sales and potential dilution over time.
